jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer II (Golang) to join our AdTech tribe. You'll help build our next-generation advertising platform that helps partners – restaurants and local shops – promote their best dishes, attract new customers, and grow their business. If you enjoy solving concrete engineering problems, growing your ownership over real production systems, and learning from a senior, distributed team, this is a great next step – and Berlin is waiting for you.

You'll join the squad owning a critical piece of the AdTech ecosystem: the Campaigns Squad, which powers the creation and management of campaigns across all Delivery Hero brands globally, and the Advertiser Service, the central solution for advertiser data. You will contribute to the scalability, performance, and resilience of these services as part of a squad supporting a global user base.

- Own and deliver well-scoped features end-to-end within the Campaigns and Advertiser services, from design input through to production.
- Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Go code that meets the team's engineering and security standards.
- Contribute to architecture and design discussions for the features you build, with guidance from senior engineers.
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other squads across the AdTech tribe to ship reliable solutions.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the services you help maintain, escalating and learning as needed.
- Participate actively in code reviews, estimations, and team ceremonies, and keep growing your technical and business understanding.

Qualifications

- 2+ years of professional software development experience, with solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
- Hands-on experience with Go (or strong proficiency in another backend language plus a genuine interest in Go) and a good understanding of service-oriented / microservices patterns.
- Experience with relational (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
- Some exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes, and a willingness to deepen this knowledge.
- A quality-first mindset: you write tests, care about readability, and are comfortable asking for and giving feedback in code reviews.
- Good communication skills and fluent English.

- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will design, build, and operate cloud-native applications that are core toSURU Connect and SURU SignalHub.Working across the full solution lifecycle, you will turn customer and business needs into scalable, secure, andreliable digital products. Using C#, modern .NET, Blazor and AWS, you will take technical ownership whilehelping shape architecture, engineering practices, and the future direction of SURU´s connected water andIoT platforms.

What You´ll Do:

- Design, develop, test, and applications for SURU Connect and SURU SignalHub, including APIs,background services, data-processing pipelines, and modern** Blazor **web applications
- Design reliable event-driven and distributed solutions on AWS using appropriate managed services,messaging, databases, and Infrastructure as Code. Integrate IoT devices, connectivity providers, externalplatforms, and customer systems, selecting the technologies andarchitectural patterns that best fit each usecase rather than being tied to a fixed stack
- Work closely with product, business, customers, and external partners to identify valuable use cases andtranslate them into effective technical solutions. Own solutions from initial concept and architecture throughimplementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation
- Continuously improve reliability, scalability, security, observability, performance, and delivery automation.Contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, and knowledge sharing, while usingAI-assisted development tools and AI agents extensively for implementation, testing, debugging,documentation, quality assurance, and automatedsoftware delivery

What You´ll Bring:

- 5+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience with cloud-based or distributed applications
- Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET, including ASP.NET Core, asynchronousprogramming, dependency injection, testing, and production-grade development
- Strong practical experience with Blazor and the ability to build maintainable web applications within the.NET ecosystem
- Solid understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures,asynchronous processing, and messaging-based integrations
- Practical experience designing and operating applications on AWS, including compute, storage,databases, messaging, security, and monitoring
- Strong experience with PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and Entity Framework Core
- Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, containers, automated testing, observability, andproduction operations
- Ability to work across the full application stack, from backend services and integrations to Blazor-baseduser interfaces
- Ability to evaluate and adopt new cloud services, frameworks, development tools, and architecturalapproaches where they provide clear technical or business value
- Strong practical experience with AI-assisted software development and coding agents, including AI-supported quality and delivery workflows
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical ownership, with the ability to work proactivelywith customers, product stakeholders, and other engineering disciplines
- Proficiency in both English and German (German at least B1)

Nice to Have:

- Experience with IoT platforms, smart metering, telemetry ingestion, MQTT, connected devices, orindustrial integrations
- Experience designing highly observable and resilient distributed systems
- An AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified Developer

What´s In It For You:

- Small, agile teams where your work and voice have real impact
- Direct influence on architecture and technical direction, with ownership across the full software lifecycle
- Freedom to choose the right tools and work with modern cloud, IoT, and AI-assisted engineeringtechnologies
- Support for attending conferences and continuing your professional development

Why Join SURU?

A pipe-related water damage incident happens every 30 seconds in Germany alone. At SURU - part of LIXIL - you will build digital solutions that make water systems smarter and more reliable. SURU Connect turnssmart-metering data into useful insights, while SURU SignalHub connects devices, IoT platforms, connectivityproviders, and downstream applications. You will work across IoT, cloud infrastructure, data processing, andmodern web applications, with real influence over how our products evolve.

Are we on the same wavelength? We are looking forward to your application!

- Play a leading role in the production of the annual global non-financial report for the group.

- Lead on projects and initiatives that contribute to the reporting readiness of the Group in relation to the new regulations (CSRD).

Qualifications

- Strong interest and experience in leading non-financial reporting and external assurance work/working directly with auditors – in the corporate setting, or at a consultancy/as an auditor.
- Ability to learn quickly, with excellent qualitative analytical skills – to understand ESRS standards on various non-financial topics and help internal partner teams collate and refine disclosure content.
- Ability to process multiple workstreams at the same time, proven project management skills and attention to detail
- Degree in a field that builds related skills, knowledge and experience in a related role, with strong stakeholder management skills.
- Fluency in English and strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; proven organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to process multiple tasks and workstreams in parallel in a dynamic environment.

This position provides a unique opportunity to shape a strong, consistent business unit narrative, support key transformation initiatives, and act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders - strengthening reputation, alignment, and impact across a complex global environment. jobs.description:
At a time when global technological developments and healthcare regulations are occurring and changing at an unprecedented rate, the success of large, complex global organizations that engage deeply in this space requires a legal/business leader who is deeply steeped in the levers, both public and private that impact this industry. To remain competitive in this rapidly changing landscape, organizations require a skilled legal counsel eager to build deeper expertise in healthcare and life sciences regulation, particularly at the EU level.

In this context, we are seeking a German-qualified lawyer with expertise in software as a medical device and healthcare regulatory law, who will support the senior legal team in managing legal and regulatory requirements in the region, especially Germany and the European Union.

About the business

Oracle's Healthcare and Life Sciences business provides industry-specific software and solutions to healthcare providers, payers, pharmaceutical, and medical device companies, and clinical research organizations. It offers a range of products and services, including cloud-based healthcare platforms, data analytics, electronic health records (EHR), and patient engagement systems. The business aims to help organizations improve patient outcomes, lower costs, and accelerate innovation. By leveraging Oracle's technology and expertise, healthcare and life science organizations can streamline their operations, gain insights from data, and make more informed decisions. Oracle also enables secure and compliant handling of sensitive healthcare data, helping organizations meet regulatory requirements and protect patient privacy. With a focus on digital transformation, Oracle's Healthcare and Life Sciences business empowers the industry to embrace modern technologies and improve overall healthcare delivery.

What you’ll do

As Legal Counsel, EMEA Health and Life Sciences, you will support the senior legal team in driving Oracle’s health and life sciences regulatory strategy and implementation in the region, working closely with senior lawyers in the team, the health and medical device regulatory teams and the health and compliance teams, along with product, sales, and consulting teams to provide succinct legal advise on EU and local regulations related to healthcare tech and life sciences products, emphasizing patient safety as a priority.

Specific Responsibilities include:

- Support in developing and implementing the health and life sciences legal regulatory strategy in the region, with a particular focus on Germany and the European Union, support the advise, and education of Oracle Life Sciences and Health staff on legal and regulatory requirements and policy initiatives.
- Support the advise and provide legal drafting, including preparation of legal memoranda and position papers, on legal regulatory issues impacting our customers’ use of Oracle products with a focus on electronic health records technologies, artificial intelligence and machine learning, software as a medical device, and life sciences clinical research.
- Monitor, research, and summarize relevant legal and regulatory developments, especially at the EU and German national level, and assess their impact on Oracle Health and Life Sciences products and services. Provide legal opinions on regulatory questions as required.
- Draft and review legal correspondence with regulatory authorities and courts, and represent Oracle in administrative proceedings as needed, under supervision of senior counsel.
- Assist in the preparation and submission of legal filings with regulatory bodies and agencies in Germany and the European Union to support Oracle’s health policy initiatives.
- Support the implementation of regulatory strategies to help ensure compliance with software as a medical device regulations within Germany and the EU.
- Contribute to projects promoting patient safety and regulatory compliance with guidance from senior legal and product teams.
- Support the review and implementation of regulatory strategies for evolving AI/ML regulations relevant to health and life sciences within the EU, as needed. Additional Responsibilities
- Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a focus on legal and regulatory requirements under EU and German law.
- Prepare legal research, detailed memoranda, legal opinions, and comprehensive case files for internal and external stakeholders.
- Support documentation and compliance initiatives related to GDPR, EHDS, and other EU health data regulations.
- Collaborate with internal teams, including product development and compliance, to advise on legal and regulatory implications and progress regulatory program goals.

What you’ll bring

- We are seeking a German qualified lawyer (First and Second State Bar Exam (Volljurist)) with 1–3 years of legal experience in healthcare or life sciences, with a demonstrated background in a law firm, the legal department of a company and/or a regulatory authority.

- Professional demeanor, confidence, and innovation with the ability to effectively communicate with colleagues and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent writing, analysis, negotiation, and research skills.
- Project management and interpersonal skills.
- Business orientation and ability to balance legal considerations with commercial priorities.
- Ability to perform in a fast-paced and continually evolving business environment.

Competencies

Collaboration You actively contribute to team efforts, value different perspectives, and work effectively with colleagues across departments to help achieve shared objectives.

Competitive edge: You stay informed about industry trends and client needs, identifying opportunities to add value and proposing fresh solutions within your area of responsibility.

Mastering complexity: You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, seeking guidance when needed, and contribute to practical solutions for complex issues in your daily tasks. jobs.occupation: The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as Junior Researcher / Pr (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
The Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as

Junior Researcher / PreDoc (Kiel or Berlin)

We are looking for up to two highly motivated Junior Researchers / PreDocs to join our dynamic research team at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy. The positions are almost full-time (75-90 percent). One position should be based in Kiel and another one optional in Kiel or in our Research Hub in Berlin. Both positions are linked to the research group by Prof. Christoph Trebesch and his ERC project on Great Power Finance.

The two positions have the following focus, respectively:

1. Digital chokepoints: geopolitical risk and telecom networks
2. International capital flows: great powers and cross-border investments across 200 years 

Your Role 

Your main role will be to contribute to cutting-edge research on one or two of the projects. The work will involve extensive data collection and rigorous empirical analysis using historical and contemporary sources. A particular focus of these roles will be archival research and the construction of novel datasets from historical records and documents related to telecommunications, computer science, financial assets and international capital flows.

As part of Christoph Trebesch’s research group, you will work closely with senior researchers on high-impact projects in macroeconomics, economic history, and political economy. The positions offer an excellent opportunity to gain advanced research experience, develop strong empirical skills, and contribute to internationally visible academic work.

Your Profile 

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

- ·         Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in economics (completed or close to completion) with very good grades.
- ·         Strong quantitative and empirical skills and experience, particularly:
- For position (1): experience with data on telecommunication and computer science
- For position (2): experience with data on financial assets and/or international capital flows, ideally also historical financial data
- ·         Experience with advanced AI tools and statistical software such as Stata, R, and/or Python.
- ·         Interest in historical research and archival work.
- ·         Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment. 
- ·         Excellent analytical and organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality research.
- The working language is English; excellent English skills are therefore required. Some knowledge of German would be useful, but is not important.

We are offering 

The planned contract period is 10 months (starting in the fall of 2026). The salary will be based on the German public sector pay scale at grade EG 12 or 13 TV L. The position is part-time between 75-90%.

The Kiel Institute for the World Economy values diversity. We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age or sexual orientation. The Kiel Institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/equal-opportunity/) . We promote the professional opportunities of women and strongly encourage them to apply. Women with equivalent qualifications, competence and expertise will be given preference. We are committed to employing persons with recognized disabilities and will therefore give them preference over persons without disabilities if they are equally qualified. 

In order to be eligible for this position you have to hold EU citizenship or need to be able to provide a work permit that is valid throughout the time of your contract.

Please submit your application online (https://www.kielinstitut.de/institute/career/job-vacancies/junior-researcher-/-predoc-kiel-or-berlin/) using ID-No. “PreDoc_2026”. Please include (i) a letter of interest, (ii) your CV, (iii) one or two work samples (e.g. Bachelor’s or Master’s thesis), (iv) university transcripts, as well as (if applicable) (v) proofs of relevant work experience. Ideally submit just one PDF, including “PreDoc” and your family name as file name. The deadline for applications is September 7, 2026 Application photos should not be included. 

For additional information, please contact Prof. Christoph Trebesch (christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de (https://mailto:christoph.trebesch@kielinstitut.de) ).

If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Data Scientist to join the Logistics Optimization team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

In our Logistics Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

The Optimization Tribe's purpose is to maximize Delivery Hero's logistics performance. We achieve this by owning and continuously improving the sophisticated algorithm that solves the real-time vehicle routing problem, assigning orders efficiently every minute. This directly impacts DH's core efficiency and customer satisfaction KPIs, influencing decisions for stakeholders from Operations to Product.

As a Data Scientist, your value lies in tackling these fascinating problems head-on and building ML products which shape the algorithm's logic and decisions to meet our long-term goals of best-in-class efficiency and service, making a tangible impact across the Delivery Hero network.

- Design & Innovate: Lead the conceptualization and design of advanced modeling solutions (using a mix of ML, Statistics and Math) to tackle complex, large-scale Logistics challenges, ensuring alignment with business value and stakeholder needs.
- Build & Automate: Take ownership of developing, implementing and automating robust data science models and pipelines, including feature generation, retraining, and prediction deployment, leveraging tools like BigQuery and Spark as needed.
- Solve & Collaborate: Actively drive technical discussions and problem-solving sessions, contributing significant expertise and innovative ideas to overcome the toughest modeling hurdles alongside your Data Science peers and squad lead.
- Drive Business Impact: Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics.
- Shape Data Strategy: Proactively engage with Data & ML Engineering and Tech teams to define critical data requirements and influence technical roadmaps, ensuring the necessary data infrastructure for impactful projects.
- Contribute & Elevate: Make a significant impact within our fast-paced, global organization by delivering high-quality solutions, sharing knowledge, and contributing to the team's overall growth and best practices.

Qualifications

- Applied Machine Learning Mastery: You have significant experience (ideally 3+ years) designing and implementing diverse machine learning models (e.g., regression, classification, tree-based ensembles) to solve real-world business problems, backed by a strong theoretical foundation in statistics and probability.
- Production ML Engineering: You possess expert-level Python skills (incl. pandas, scikit-learn, etc.), proficiency in SQL, and demonstrable experience building robust, maintainable, and automated ML pipelines using Big Data technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Spark) and workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Metaflow), applying software engineering best practices.
- Problem Translation & Critical Thinking: You excel at translating ambiguous business requirements into well-defined technical problems and data science solutions, critically evaluating assumptions and ensuring data quality throughout the process.
- Communication & Influence: You are a strong communicator, capable of clearly explaining complex technical concepts, model intuition, and business implications to diverse audiences (both technical and non-technical stakeholders).
- Collaboration & Team Orientation: You are a proactive team player with proven experience collaborating effectively with peers and cross-functional teams (like Data Engineering and Tech) in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Fluency in English is required.

Nice to have:

- Operations Research (OR) Expertise: Deeper experience applying Operations Research techniques to solve optimization problems relevant to logistics.
- Advanced Experimentation & Causal Inference: Proven track record in designing, implementing, and analyzing complex experiments (beyond standard A/B tests) or applying causal inference methods.
- Data Application/Dashboarding Skills: Experience building interactive data visualizations, applications, or dashboards using libraries like Streamlit, Plotly Dash, or similar tools to communicate results effectively.

jobs.description:
The Leibniz Institute for Agricultural Engineering and Bioeconomy (ATB) is a pioneer and a driver of bioeconomy research. We create the scientific foundation to transform agricultural, food, industrial and energy systems into a sustainable bio-based circular economy. We develop and integrate techniques, processes and management strategies, effectively converging technologies to intelligently crosslink highly diverse bioeconomic production systems and to control them in a knowledge-based, adaptive and largely automated manner. We conduct research in dialogue with society, policymakers, industry and other stakeholders - knowledge-driven and application-inspired.

As part of the HORIZON project ‘Towards scalable monitoring, reporting, verification and mitigation of non-CO2 greenhouse gas and ammonia emissions from land-based agricultural systems (MARVELA)’, we are looking, subject to funding approval, for a

Scientist (PostDoc) (m/f/d) (100 %)

for the task area 

Development and validation of IoT-based sensor systems for environmental monitoring

Within the MARVELA project, innovative, cost-effective and user-friendly measurement systems for the continuous monitoring of greenhouse gases, ammonia and relevant environmental parameters at farm level will be developed, optimized and validated. At ATB, the work focuses on the further development of modular IoT-based sensor systems, the integration of sensors, embedded electronics and communication interfaces, and their application in livestock buildings and manure-management systems. The developed systems will be tested under laboratory and practical farm conditions and validated against state-of-the-art reference measurement methods.

Your tasks

Your main responsibility will be the development, implementation and scientific validation of electronic measurement systems for agricultural emission monitoring. This includes in particular:

- Further development and optimization of modular IoT-based sensor systems for environmental and emission monitoring
- Integration of sensors, embedded electronics, data loggers, power supplies and communication interfaces into robust measurement systems
- Programming and configuration of microcontrollers, device interfaces and automated data-acquisition systems
- Planning and conducting laboratory tests, calibrations and measurement campaigns in livestock and manure-management systems
- Validation of low-cost and mid-cost sensors against state-of-the-art reference measurement instruments
- Development and implementation of quality-assurance procedures, measurement protocols and technical documentation
- Processing, quality control, statistical analysis and interpretation of measurement data
- Coordination of technical activities with project partners and preparation of scientific publications, reports and presentations

Your qualifications

- Successfully completed doctorate in electrical engineering, mechatronics, technical informatics, embedded systems, measurement and sensor technology, physical engineering or a comparable discipline
- Proven experience in scientific project management
- Proven experience in the development, integration and operation of measurement and sensor systems
- Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers and hardware-related programming
- Knowledge of common device interfaces and communication protocols, such as I²C, SPI, UART, RS-485, Modbus, Ethernet or LoRaWAN
- Experience in sensor calibration, measurement-system validation, quality assurance and systematic troubleshooting
- Strong programming and data-analysis skills, preferably in Python, R, MATLAB, C or C++
- Very good English skills, an independent and solution-oriented working style, teamwork, willingness to conduct field measurements
- Desirable: Good command of German, EU driving licence class B

We offer

- An attractive, interdisciplinary and international working environment with a highly motivated team
- An exciting position in a cutting-edge field of environmental monitoring and sensor technology
- Excellent infrastructure with state-of-the-art laboratory and measurement technology
- Access to national and international networks for your scientific development
- Training and further education opportunities
- Family-friendly working conditions to promote work-life balance
- Financial contribution to VBB company ticket or Deutschlandticket
- A workplace at the edge of a picturesque landscape, easily accessible by bike or public transport

The full-time position (40 hours/week) is initially limited to 3 years. Part-time employment is also possible if desired. Salary will be based on your qualifications and experience according to TV-L up to pay grade 13. The preferred starting date is in Q1 2027.

For more information, please contact Dr.-Ing. David Janke (Tel.: +49 331-5699 513) and on the Internet at www.atb-potsdam.de (http://www.atb-potsdam.de) .

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials at the interface between materials science and synthetic biology, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. The multidisciplinary component of our research requires intensive information and data exchange between multiple disciplines. We work on semantically structured data and interfaces, AI-driven workflows, and contribute to engaging the growing ELM community in digitalized research.

To support the digitalization of SynBio work within the context of ELM development, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Synthetic Biology (f/m/d)

and interest in data-driven research. The position is integrated in the collaborative network MaterialVital Hub, recently funded by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) in collaboration with the Galaxy Community Hub. The candidate will be part of a team of experimental scientists and research data management experts at INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials and Bioinformaticians at the University of Freiburg.

Your roles:

- Contribute to the digitalization of synthetic biology workflows for ELM development in collaboration with SynBio researchers at INM.
- Develop metadata schemas for typical synthetic biology steps and methodologies in ELM research which are transferable to electronic LabBooks and data platforms of relevance for other researchers within the MaterialVital Hub.
- Contribute to the development of an ELM-dedicated ontology for interoperability within the MaterialVital Hub in cooperation with MaterialDigital Platform partners and the Galaxy Community Hub.
- Support and promote digitalization of the ELM community within the MaterialVital Hub in close interaction with Galaxi Community Hub and MaterialDigital Platform and NFDI.
- Attend workshops and disseminate your work within the ELM community by presenting at conferences and scientific events.
- Document your work and report to project coordinators and stakeholders.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in synthetic biology, biotechnology or related disciplines.
- Experience as experimental researcher in combination with modelling or data-driven methods is ideal. Previous experience as data steward, or previous work within NFDI Consortia is of advantage. Knowledge in automated workflows for SynBio research is advantageous.
- Interest in working with and for the digitalization of the ELM community.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- An emergent research topic with multiple opportunities to contribute and interact with the growing community and contribute to its development at an early stage.
- Direct access to and high visibility in the SynBio and ELM networks at national and international level.
- An existing team with expertise and drive to move forward digitalization in ELM research. A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- A community-oriented, multifaceted work with great scope for creativity.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- Strong support of training and career development towards an outstanding profile as data scientist in synthetic biology research.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 3 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by**_ September 15th, 2026 _**via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

AugustThe Kiel Institute for the World Economy seeks applications for a position as

Postdoctoral Researcher

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic research team at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy. The position is full-time and will either be based at our headquarters in Kiel or at our Research Hub in Berlin.

Your Role 

Your main role will be to contribute to cutting-edge research at the intersection of political economy, development economics, and economic history.

A central focus of the position is the study of the determinants, consequences, and long-run effects of conflicts, including its implications for institutions, political representation, governance, and economic development.

The position is particularly suited to scholars whose research examines how political and historical institutions shape economic, political, and social outcomes, with a particular interest in inequality, governance, political participation, state capacity, and long-run development. 

As part of Moritz Schularick's research team, you will work closely with senior researchers on high-impact projects with strong academic and policy relevance. The position offers an excellent opportunity to develop an independent research agenda, publish in leading international journals, collaborate with an international network of researchers, and contribute to externally funded research projects.

Your Profile 

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

- ·         PhD in Economics
- ·         Strong research background in macroeconomics, international economics, finance, political economy, or related fields.
- ·         Excellent quantitative and econometric skills.
- A strong, proven record of prior research on conflicts, economic, political and social influences on their outcomes, as well as their (long-lasting) effects is a necessary essential asset. The record should be demonstrated by the candidate’s CV and submitted research papers (see below).
- ·         Demonstrated experience working with modern empirical methods.
- ·         Demonstrated experience working with historical data.
- ·         Strong programming skills in Stata, R, Python, Julia, Matlab, or comparable software.
- ·         Evidence of research excellence through high-quality working papers or publications.
- ·         Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative research projects.
- ·         Excellent communication skills and fluency in spoken and written English. 

We are offering 

The position is scheduled to start on September 1, 2026, and is limited to two years. The salary will be based on the German public sector pay scale at grade EG 13 TV-L. The position is full-time.

We are committed to employing persons with recognized disabilities and will therefore give them preference over persons without disabilities if they are equally qualified. 

In order to be eligible for this position you have to hold EU citizenship or need to be able to provide a work permit that is valid throughout the time of your contract.

jobs.employer_name: ZOE Institute for Future-Fit Economies gUG
jobs.description:
Who we are

ZOE, the Institute for Future-Fit Economies, is an independent think & do tank active in Germany and in Brussels . We are dedicated to policy-oriented research and evidence-driven advocacy for a futurefit economy. At the interface of politics, research, and civil society in the EU, we develop impulses for an economy that enables people to live well within planetary boundaries.

We offer:

- A motivating working environment in a small think & do tank that has become an established actor in Brussels in a short space of time
- A strategic, agile, value and purpose-oriented working style
- Flexibility of working time and place, supporting a healthy work-life-balance

The role

The Economics of a Green and Just Transition team is seeking a trainee to support policy and research work across several projects related to financing and implementing a green and just transition. The trainee will help develop content and analytical materials, contribute to EU-level policy analysis, and may also support an industry-focused project with a particular emphasis on Germany.

Key responsibilities

As part of a motivated and impact-driven team you will carry out a variety of tasks, including: − Background research and analysis on various topics

- Drafting content for reports, policy briefs and other publications
- Preparation of presentations and key documents
- Preparing briefings for key stakeholder meetings
- Support in monitoring of current economic policy events and debates
- Support in the organization of events (physical and online)

Core competences

We are looking for people that share our core principles: value orientation, sustainability, agility, selforganisation .

Your profile would include the following skills, background , and knowledge:

- Excellent command of English and German , both oral and written -
- Master’s degree in economics/ political economy /European studies /public policy
- Interest in economic policy topics like fiscal policy and industrial policy
- Ability to work independently and in teams
- Strong analytical skills
- Strategic mindset

In addition, some of the following competencies fit well into our team but are not a requirement: -

- Knowledge of legislative processes in the EU and/or Germany
- Qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
- Based in Brussels or Berlin

Conditions

We are looking for someone to join our team for 38 hours per week for 6 months. The position will start ideally in October 2026. We offer the possibility to work remotely from Germany , the Netherlands, or Belgium or to work from our offices in Cologne, Berlin, and Brussels.

The gross monthly salary for full-time is 2289 euros, prorated for fewer hours. The remuneration for this position is based on our internal salary framework, informed by the collective agreement of the public service of the Länder. For a full-time (38 hours) position, 30 holiday days are offered for one calendar year.

In addition to this, ZOE offers several benefits such as additional days off for volunteering and reimbursement for public transportation.

Diversity

We believe that our society’s behaviour disproportionately hurts the most marginali sed people – including people of colour, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women and LGBTIQ people. We are committed to challenge this through our work for socially just development and by creating a diverse workplace at our organisation . Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people who are members of marginali sed communities.

Application procedure

Please send your applications by 30 August. Please send : a) your CV (max 3 pages), b) a motivation letter (400–500 words) explaining why you would like to work with ZOE Institute and c) a sample of your work (power point slides, publication, press release or similar) to applications@zoe-institut.de. Please do not attach a photo to your application. Please state “Economic Policy Trainee” in the subject line.
If we shortlist you for an interview, we will get back to you as soon as possible with dates for an online interview. In case of any questions please contact applications@zoe-institut.de. Thank you very much for your interest in ZOE Institute .

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As an Expert Business Partner (f/m/d), you will be a key finance business partner within the TI Compression Business Controlling team. You will take a leading role in orchestrating forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and preliminary actuals across the organization. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior management, you will ensure financial transparency, challenge business performance, and provide actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead the consolidation, validation, and submission of forecasts while steering monthly reporting, preliminary actuals, and quarterly closing activities
* Lead and coordinate annual budgeting and long-term financial planning processes across multiple entities and stakeholders
* Own the analysis of actuals, forecasts, budgets, and prior-period results, identifying key business drivers, variances, risks, and opportunities
* Challenge and translate financial results into actionable business insights and develop compelling narrative reporting for senior management
* Act as a strategic finance partner to Controllers, Business Departments, Functional Stakeholders, and CP Management, including interaction with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Drive global continuous improvements across planning, reporting, data quality, and forecasting accuracy while leading cross-functional and international initiatives

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
* Significant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Business Controlling, or Corporate Finance, ideally gained in medium-sized to large international organizations; M&A experience is a plus
* Strong international and cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to lead and influence stakeholders across functions, entities, and cultures
* Strong understanding of financial statements, business drivers, and performance metrics, ideally gained in a manufacturing, industrial, or project-driven environment
* Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing 
electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We 
enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and 
integrated execution capabilities

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: PhD candidate in the Research Department Nanooptics (f/d/m) (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
PhD candidate in the Research Department Nanooptics (f/d/m) in Jena

The Leibniz Institute of Photonics Technology (Leibniz IPHT (https://www.leibniz-ipht.de/en/homepage/) ) offers the following position in the Research Department Nanooptics (https://www.leibniz-ipht.de/en/departments/nanooptics/) for a part-time (65%) position, starting as soon as possible:

PhD candidate (f/m/d)

The position is initially limited to 3 years. An extension will be sought if suitable.

The Leibniz-IPHT is a university independent research institute with close connection to the Friedrich-Schiller-University Jena (https://www.uni-jena.de/en) and member of the Leibniz association (https://www.leibniz-gemeinschaft.de/en/institutes/leibniz-institutes-all-lists) .

Job description:

The PhD candidate is expected to join us to work on the research project “Light-driven microdrones”, which is based on the collaboration between Dr. Xiaofei Wu at Leibniz-IPHT and Prof. Bert Hecht at University of Würzburg. Light-driven microdrones are micrometer-sized robots actuated by multiple independent optical nanomotors, which generate thrusts upon light illumination. Up to date, we have developed microdrones working in a plane with full and independent controls in all 3 degrees of freedom of 2D motions, which is a breakthrough for light-driven robotic devices (see https://communities.springernature.com/posts/light-driven-microdrones-a-new-level-of-optical-manipulation).

We are now aiming to extend the operation space of the microdrones to 3D. The two PhD candidates at Leibniz-IPHT and University of Würzburg will work together to achieve this goal by fulfilling a few challenging tasks. Once the whole microdrone system is established, we will perform experiments to showcase the great potential of the microdrones for future applications. The current idea is to do tip-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (TERS) of cells or similar specimens.

Your field of activity includes:

- Use numerical simulations (FDTD, COMSOL, deep learning) to design efficient nanomotors of the microdrones for 3D control
- Develop microfluidic chips as experimental platform of the microdrones. Fabricate the microfluidic chips using photolithography and 3D nano/microprinting (e.g. Nanoscribe).
- Contribute to fabrications of the microdrones using FIB, EBL, transfer, etc.
- Conduct the experiments of TERS on biological specimens

Qualification:

- Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or related fields (such as biophotonics, nanotechnology).

Desired skills and abilities

- Enthusiasm in research of frontier science and technology
- Strong problem-solving drive and ambition for excellence
- Solid knowledge in electromagnetics and optics
- Experience in optical experiments
- Experience in programming (Python, Matlab, etc.) is a plus
- Experience in micro/nanofabrication is a plus
- Good communication skills in English (spoken and written)
- Independence, responsibility and team player

We offer:

- An open welcoming culture and an inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment: Located on the Beutenberg campus in Jena, Leibniz-IPHT is home to more than 400 employees from around the world working at the interface of physics, biochemistry, technology, data science and medicine to develop the photonic technologies of tomorrow.
- World-class equipment and facilities: Leibniz-IPHT has a large number of physics, chemistry and biology laboratories at the highest level. It also has state-of-the-art fiber drawing and clean room facilities (including lithography facilities) as well as microfluidics fabrication and big data computing facilities.
- Thorough and comprehensive personal training: Transferring good practices in scientific working and outreach is one of our main focus points. In a respectful and appreciative environment, you will learn everything you need for a career inside and outside of science. Moreover, plenty of workshops and opportunities for scientific exchange are offered by the Leibniz IPHT, as well as the Abbe School of Photonics and the Graduate Academy of the Friedrich-Schiller University Jena.
- A family-friendly working environment with support offers for the compatibility of family and work (e.g. parent-child office, campus kindergarten places, advice on family care situations from trained care guides and much more).
- Flexible working time models as well as 30 days vacation/year, special annual payment and bridge days.
- Jena - City of Science: a young city with a vibrant local cultural agenda!

Salary:

Salary is in accordance with the regulations of the TV-L and your qualifications and experience.

About us:

We are a modern, internationally focused research institute. Work-life balance is one of our central concerns. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality or ethnic and social origin. If women are underrepresented in the area of the advertised position, they will be given preferential consideration in the hiring process if they are equally qualified.

Further information:

If you have any questions, please contact Dr. Xiaofei Wu; email: xiaofei.wu@leibniz-ipht.de.

Application:

Please simply apply until September 11, 2026 (including CV, certificates, reference addresses, others) via our job portal (https://www.leibniz-ipht.de/en/institute/career/job-portal/) (https://www.leibniz-ipht.de/en/institute/career/job-portal/).

About ForEveryone ForEveryone is a non-profit social enterprise in Berlin. We bring people from different backgrounds together, among other things through our community café at Boxhagener Platz and through workshops, events and activities for an international Berlin audience. We are growing, and we are currently reshaping our whole range of activities.

What this role is about We are looking for someone to oversee, develop and be present across our whole range of activities – from workshops to events at our community café at Boxhagener Platz (jam sessions, music nights, exhibitions and more). The clear goal: turning individual activities into recurring small communities with their own memberships. Instead of activities we have to market and fill again every time, we want formats people come back to regularly – a knitting club, a sports format, creative combinations, a recurring music night. You drive this: you sense what the community wants, develop formats to match, test them, run them yourself, recruit and support the volunteers who help carry them, and make sure the good ones actually happen and grow.

What you'll do

- Oversee and support the offering. You keep an eye on all running activities – workshops and café events alike – are regularly present on site, and make sure everything runs smoothly, including the operational side in our booking tool (cancellations, refunds, correct details) – a small but important part of the week.
- Develop and test formats and events. You sense what activities the community wants, identify new workshop, event and mini-formats, research trends and seasonal demand (what are others offering, what works in a summer lull?), and honestly test which formats land well enough to sustain, and which don't.
- Build mini-communities with memberships. You develop formats with recurring communities in mind – ones people belong to as members – and take them from first idea to an established, recurring offering.
- Run activities and enable volunteers. You run workshops and events yourself on a regular basis, at a good standard – weekly, sometimes with support from volunteers. You recruit volunteers (including from among participants), onboard them, give them direct feedback, and support them until they can carry a format.
- Guide formats through their phases. For new formats: experiment and learn from feedback. For established ones: set up clean processes, with reliability and scaling in mind.

What you bring

- Experience running workshops, events, groups or community formats, at a quality others can build on.
- A feel for people and communities, and enjoyment in recruiting and supporting volunteers.
- Conceptual strength: you can develop formats, test them, and judge honestly what works.
- Self-direction and ownership – you drive your area like a genuine project lead.

These are your core working hours. The rest of your time you can arrange flexibly from the office. This on-site presence comes with a lot of creative freedom, but it is also a clear expectation.
- Comfortable with digital tools; German and English are a strong plus for our multilingual community.

What to expect from us

- A role with real room to shape things: you are building something that doesn't exist yet.
- A small, committed team and real closeness to a lively, international community.
- We set the strategic and financial direction (e.g. the membership model) as managing directors; you develop and decide on the formats independently, with our final sign-off.

Terms

- Start: September/October 2026 or by arrangement
- Pay: €2,400–2,800 gross/month (at 36 hrs)
- Location: Coworking Kiezlab, Berlin · hybrid

Now we’re looking for someone who is hungry to sell, loves the craft of it, and wants to grow with us.

- Show Up & Show Expertise: Represent heyport at national and international maritime events, conferences, and trade forums and build strong, trusted industry network.
- Stay Process-Sharp: Maintain clean CRM hygiene, structured pipeline management, and a continuous drive to improve how we sell - tools, sequences, qualification frameworks, all of it.
- Collaborate for Success: Work closely with our founders, product, and customer success colleagues. Your feedback from the field directly shapes the product and messaging.

What you bring to the table

- Experience in B2B sales or business development, with real exposure to a full sales cycle - ideally in a maritime, logistics, or SaaS environment.
- A genuine passion for sales as a craft - you enjoy prospecting, demos, objection handling, and closing, and you’re motivated to continuously improve how you sell.
- Confidence working across multiple outreach channels (e.g. email, LinkedIn, IM, and the phone). Cold calling doesn't scare you.
- Hands-on experience with CRM systems, outreach tooling, sales sequences, and pipeline management.
- Fluent English is a must. Additional languages (e.g. Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic) are a real asset in our international sales environment.
- Strong communication and presentation skills, paired with the ability to listen, ask the right questions, and adapt to different counterparts
- Entrepreneurial, ownership-driven mindset - you’re comfortable building processes as you go, working with incomplete structures, and traveling internationally (a reasonable amount - we don’t live in airports).

Are you interested, but don't meet all the requirements? Let's talk!

What we offer you

- Real ownership: You will take on full responsibility for your role and outcomes. Your pipeline, your deals, your growth.
- Room to grow fast: As heyport scales, your responsibility, and development opportunities grow with it.
- Competitive compensation package, including performance-based incentives: 60.000€ - 75.000€
- Flexibility for a healthy work-life balance: Mobile working and trust-based working hours - we care about output, not attendance.
- A central workplace in Hamburg’s Speicherstadt: One of the best office locations in Germany, right between HafenCity and the city centre (and yes, the coffee is good).
- A small, focused team: We work closely together, taking our work seriously, but not ourselves too much.

jobs.description:
About Infront

At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets. 

For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. 

Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading & Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed. 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially focused Pre-Sales Specialist to support the growth of our Infront Quant Valuation & Risk offering (IQ Risk) and our independent Valuation Services across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Luxembourg.

Working as a trusted advisor alongside regional Sales Executives, you will engage with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle, demonstrating how our multi-asset risk analytics and independent valuation services address the complex needs of banks, asset managers, insurers, pension funds, fund administrators, AIFMs, family offices and institutional investors.

This is a quota-carrying role with co-prime responsibility for the achievement of sales targets for the in-scope Valuation & Risk product suite. Success requires a combination of strong business acumen, quantitative and financial markets expertise, regulatory knowledge, and the ability to articulate business value to both executive and operational stakeholders.

This position is based in Frankfurt am Main, where you will work closely with our quant analysts, model developers, and valuation service specialists, gaining direct access to the expertise behind IQ Risk and our independent valuation offerings.

As our Pre-Sales Specialist, you will:

- Partner with Regional Sales Executives to develop account strategies, drive revenue growth, and support commercial negotiations across assigned territories.
- Qualify client business, functional, quantitative, and technical requirements, contributing to opportunity planning, competitive positioning, and solution design.
- Deliver demonstrations, proof of concepts, valuation benchmarks, solution proposals, and technical validation activities tailored to client needs.
- Lead discovery workshops to understand valuation policies, risk measurement processes, market data requirements, and regulatory obligations.
- Design and present solution architectures, including API, data feed, and file-based integrations, that align client requirements with product capabilities.
- Act as a subject matter expert for valuation methodologies, risk analytics, and relevant regulatory frameworks, while positioning Infront Quant's independent approach against alternative solutions.
- Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across investments, risk, valuation, operations, compliance, fund accounting, and technology functions, articulating the business value and ROI of our solutions to audiences ranging from end users to executive leadership.
- Collaborate closely with Quant Analytics, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams, sharing market and regulatory insights to support product development, competitive positioning, and sales success.
- Travel regularly across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and Luxembourg to support client meetings, workshops, industry events, and internal collaboration.

Who you are

- Proven experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Consulting, or Solution Engineering supporting enterprise SaaS, financial technology, or quantitative analytics solutions.
- Strong understanding of valuation, risk analytics, capital markets, and financial instruments, ideally across fixed income, derivatives, and structured products.
- Experience supporting complex, consultative B2B sales cycles and engaging with senior business and technical stakeholders.
- Excellent presentation, demonstration, and workshop facilitation skills.
Ability to translate business, regulatory, and operational challenges into effective technology and service solutions.
- Commercially minded with experience working toward revenue targets or shared sales objectives.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence both business and technical audiences.
- Self-motivated and comfortable working across multiple countries, cultures, and stakeholder groups.
- Knowledge of valuation and risk management solutions, market data vendors, APIs, cloud technologies, quantitative risk concepts, and RFP/RFI processes is advantageous.
- Fluent German and English are essential; additional European language skills are considered a strong advantage.
- A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, as well as professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, CAIA, or equivalent, are considered a strong advantage.

Our Offer

**Health & wellness:** Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.

**Holiday:** Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.

**Pension:** Plan for your long-term financial wellbeing through our pension scheme, supported by employer contributions.

**Remote work:** Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.

**Learning & development:** Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.

**Culture & impact:** Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.

**Our offices:** Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.

Additional notes

*Note: Since your application will be reviewed by an international team, we kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

All candidates selected for employment are subject to pre-employment screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.

We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. Would you like to be part of Apple’s fast-growing RF wireless design team in Munich? We are responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development with a particular emphasis on highly integrated, power efficient designs and advanced semiconductor technologies that enable an outstanding user experience. IC design engineers work on circuit and system solutions for sophisticated wireless chips. As a RF Design Engineer at Apple, you will use your vast background in circuit design and provide PLL design solutions for wireless chips. You will collaborate with platform architects, system group, and digital design group to define the requirements for a PLL lineup based on the product requirements. You will also work with the Apple technology team and silicon foundries on process evaluation/selection for the target device. You will work with system engineering, layout, and chip integration teams to integrate the IP’s and verify the top-level functionality and performance. You also will work with RF test engineers to bring up, characterize and optimize new silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- Profound experience in RF circuit design techniques.
- Experience with Cadence design tools.
- EM modelling and simulation skills.
- MSEE /PhD or equivalent is required.
- Proficiency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

- A proven track record in RF, and analog integrated circuit design, with experience in wireless PLL circuit architectures in CMOS technologies.
- Deep understanding in PLL system specifications and the ability to work with system architects to translate system requirements into circuit requirements at IC block level. 
- Knowledge in fundamental RF theories and concepts, such as innovative PLL concepts and their trade-offs in key performance parameters (KPI’s), area and power efficiency.
- The ability to optimize the overall PLL system including EVM, blocker requirements and crosstalk mitigations.
- Deep technical knowledge in analysis, design, and implementation of RF wireless low-noise, broadband and power efficient PLLs, as well as frequency converting blocks.

- Solid experience in optimization of RF circuit design impairments by means of highly sophisticated methods of trimming and calibration

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the SAP S/4HANA Rollout Cutover Lead (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in ensuring successful business transitions across Siemens Energy's global S4E Unify transformation program. You will define and govern the overall cutover strategy, coordinate global and local deployment activities, and ensure all business, IT, and third-party teams are fully prepared for go-live.

Working closely with Rollout Managers, Template Teams, Cluster Cutover Managers, business stakeholders, and external partners, you will oversee integrated cutover planning, manage critical dependencies and risks, and drive business readiness throughout every rollout wave. Your leadership will help ensure smooth, controlled, and low-risk transitions into the new SAP S/4HANA environment.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Own and drive the global SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, ensuring a controlled, business-ready transition across all rollout waves
* Develop and maintain integrated cutover plans covering data migration, system validation, go-live activities, legacy system integration, and decommissioning
* Define governance, readiness criteria, key milestones, and decision gates while ensuring all deployment dependencies are managed effectively
* Identify cutover risks early, develop contingency and fallback strategies, and lead issue resolution to minimize business disruption during critical go-live periods
* Guide and support Cluster Cutover Managers by providing standardized methodologies, coordinating execution, and ensuring alignment with global deployment objectives
* Monitor cutover performance through KPIs, status reporting, and governance meetings while providing clear, decision-oriented updates to Program Management and executive stakeholders

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
* Extensive experience leading SAP S/4HANA cutover, deployment, transition, or large-scale ERP transformation programs in complex global environments
* Strong expertise in integrated cutover planning, data migration, system validation, go-live management, legacy system integration, and operational readiness
* Proven experience in risk management, contingency planning, business continuity, milestone tracking, KPI reporting, and executive-level communication
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate business stakeholders, global delivery organizations, Cluster Cutover Managers, and external implementation partners
* Fluent English is required; German or additional languages relevant to the rollout regions are considered an advantage

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). Its key objective is to transform our historical patchwork of 23 legacy SAP systems into a completely new platform based on the latest state-of-the-art SAP S/4 HANA technology. At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Goal is to significantly reduce complexity, increase speed and flexibility, foster cross-organizational collaboration and finally drive significant cost reductions. The S4E-Unify core team consists of roughly 300 colleagues around the globe plus a substantial extended community of subject matter experts (SME), change network ambassadors and other contributors. It affects 40,000 global users and follows an implementation roadmap through 2030.  The S4E program is delivered through phased “Unify” rollout waves, bringing sites and business areas live step by step on SAP S/4HANA. It includes standardized business templates, a defined operating model with strong governance and board‑level sponsorship, and an enhanced user experience that modernizes how employees work.

As a Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d), you will support recruiting activities for Gas Services while partnering closely with business leaders, HR Business Partners, and a global Talent Acquisition network. * Operational leadership and coaching of project teams, ensuring effective workload allocation, capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery against KPIs and service level expectations
